fields.title: Accountant
fields.short_description: Manage financial records, prepare reports and support financial decision-making.
fields.description: Accountants prepare financial statements, maintain accounting records, analyse transactions and help organisations understand their financial position.
fields.education_requirements: Accounting, Accounting and Finance, Finance or a related qualification.
fields.career_progression: Accounts Assistant → Accountant → Senior Accountant → Finance Manager → Financial Controller → CFO.
fields.industries: Banking, insurance, manufacturing, consulting, government and private businesses.
fields.recommended_skills: Financial Accounting, Excel, Financial Reporting, Attention to Detail, Analytical Thinking
fields.salary_notes: Entry-level estimates and estimates after five years of service. Net monthly salary. Senior-level figures not independently verified.

fields.title: External Auditor
fields.short_description: Independently examine financial statements and organisational records.
fields.description: External auditors assess whether an organisation presents its financial information fairly and complies with relevant accounting standards and regulations.
fields.education_requirements: Accounting or Accounting and Finance, followed by relevant professional qualifications.
fields.career_progression: Audit Associate → Audit Senior → Audit Manager → Audit Partner.
fields.industries: Audit firms, consulting, financial services and public institutions.
fields.recommended_skills: Auditing, Financial Reporting, Risk Assessment, Critical Thinking, Professional Ethics

fields.title: Internal Auditor
fields.short_description: Evaluate internal controls, operational processes and organisational risks.
fields.description: Internal auditors examine business processes and controls to identify weaknesses, improve accountability and reduce organisational risks.
fields.education_requirements: Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or a related programme.
fields.career_progression: Internal Audit Assistant → Internal Auditor → Audit Manager → Chief Audit Executive.
fields.industries: Banks, insurance companies, government, manufacturing and multinational organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Internal Controls, Risk Management, Auditing, Problem Solving, Integrity

fields.title: Tax Consultant
fields.short_description: Help individuals and organisations understand and manage their tax obligations.
fields.description: Tax consultants advise clients on taxation, tax compliance, tax planning and the interpretation of applicable tax rules.
fields.education_requirements: Accounting, Finance or a related business qualification, with relevant tax training.
fields.career_progression: Tax Assistant → Tax Consultant → Senior Tax Manager → Tax Director.
fields.industries: Accounting firms, consulting, government and corporate organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Taxation, Financial Analysis, Research, Attention to Detail

fields.title: Financial Analyst
fields.short_description: Analyse financial information to support investment and business decisions.
fields.description: Financial analysts examine financial statements, business performance, budgets and market information to help organisations make informed decisions.
fields.education_requirements: Finance, Accounting, Banking and Finance, Business Economics or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: Finance Assistant → Financial Analyst → Senior Analyst → Finance Manager → Finance Director.
fields.industries: Banks, insurance, investment firms, consulting, energy and multinational companies.
fields.recommended_skills: Financial Modelling, Advanced Excel, Financial Statement Analysis, Power BI, Analytical Thinking
fields.salary_notes: Entry-level estimates and estimates after five years of service. Net monthly salary. Senior-level figures not independently verified.

fields.title: Investment Analyst
fields.short_description: Research financial markets, companies and investment opportunities.
fields.description: Investment analysts evaluate companies, securities and financial markets to support investment recommendations and portfolio decisions.
fields.education_requirements: Finance, Accounting, Economics, Actuarial Science or a related qualification.
fields.career_progression: Research Assistant → Investment Analyst → Senior Analyst → Portfolio Manager → Investment Director.
fields.industries: Investment banking, asset management, pension funds and financial institutions.
fields.recommended_skills: Investment Analysis, Financial Modelling, Valuation, Excel, Research

fields.title: Credit Analyst
fields.short_description: Evaluate borrowers and assess their ability to repay loans.
fields.description: Credit analysts assess the financial position, credit history and repayment capacity of individuals and businesses before lending decisions are made.
fields.education_requirements: Banking and Finance, Accounting, Business Economics or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: Credit Assistant → Credit Analyst → Senior Credit Analyst → Credit Manager → Risk Director.
fields.industries: Commercial banks, microfinance institutions, fintech companies and lending organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Credit Risk Analysis, Financial Statement Analysis, Excel, Risk Assessment, Decision Making
fields.salary_notes: Credit and loans officers occupational benchmark. Includes credit analyst roles. Net monthly estimates; mid-level represents estimates after five years.

fields.title: Banking Officer
fields.short_description: Support banking operations, customer accounts and financial services.
fields.description: Banking officers work in banking operations, customer services, account management, lending and other financial services.
fields.education_requirements: Banking and Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or Management.
fields.career_progression: Banking Assistant → Banking Officer → Branch Operations Manager → Branch Manager.
fields.industries: Commercial banks, rural banks, microfinance institutions and fintech companies.
fields.recommended_skills: Banking Operations, Financial Analysis, Customer Service, Problem Solving

fields.title: Risk Analyst
fields.short_description: Identify, measure and monitor financial and operational risks.
fields.description: Risk analysts examine potential threats to an organisation and develop methods to measure, monitor and reduce their impact.
fields.education_requirements: Finance, Accounting, Actuarial Science, Business Economics or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: Risk Assistant → Risk Analyst → Risk Manager → Chief Risk Officer.
fields.industries: Banking, insurance, energy, consulting and investment management.
fields.recommended_skills: Risk Management, Data Analysis, Excel, Statistical Analysis, Critical Thinking

fields.title: Insurance Analyst
fields.short_description: Analyse insurance performance, policies, claims and business risks.
fields.description: Insurance analysts support insurance operations through financial analysis, underwriting information, claims analysis and risk reporting.
fields.education_requirements: Actuarial Science, Banking and Finance, Accounting or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: Insurance Assistant → Insurance Analyst → Senior Analyst → Insurance Manager.
fields.industries: Life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, brokerage and consulting.
fields.recommended_skills: Insurance Principles, Risk Analysis, Excel, Data Analysis, Analytical Thinking

fields.title: Actuarial Analyst
fields.short_description: Use mathematics and statistics to measure financial uncertainty.
fields.description: Actuarial analysts use mathematical models, probability and statistics to evaluate financial risks, insurance liabilities and future uncertainties.
fields.education_requirements: Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a closely related quantitative qualification.
fields.career_progression: Actuarial Assistant → Actuarial Analyst → Senior Actuary → Actuarial Manager → Chief Actuary.
fields.industries: Insurance, reinsurance, pensions, banking and consulting.
fields.recommended_skills: Probability and Statistics, Financial Mathematics, Excel, Python, Analytical Thinking
fields.salary_notes: Mathematicians, actuaries and statisticians occupational benchmark. Net monthly estimates.

fields.title: Economist
fields.short_description: Study economic trends, markets and policies.
fields.description: Economists research how individuals, businesses and governments make economic decisions and analyse the effects of economic policies and market changes.
fields.education_requirements: Business Economics, Economics, Statistics or a related quantitative programme.
fields.career_progression: Research Assistant → Economist → Senior Economist → Economic Adviser → Director.
fields.industries: Government, central banking, financial institutions, research organisations and international development.
fields.recommended_skills: Economic Analysis, Econometrics, Statistics, Research, Critical Thinking
fields.salary_notes: Entry-level estimates and estimates after five years of service. Net monthly salary. Senior-level figures not independently verified.

fields.title: Data Analyst
fields.short_description: Turn raw data into useful information for business decisions.
fields.description: Data analysts collect, clean, organise and analyse information to identify patterns, answer business questions and communicate insights.
fields.education_requirements: Data Science and Analytics, Applied Statistics, Information Technology, Business Economics or Business Administration with additional analytics training.
fields.career_progression: Junior Data Analyst → Data Analyst → Senior Data Analyst → Analytics Manager → Head of Analytics.
fields.industries: Banking, insurance, telecommunications, retail, healthcare, government and energy.
fields.recommended_skills: Microsoft Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, Data Visualisation, Problem Solving

fields.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
fields.short_description: Build dashboards and reporting systems that help businesses make better decisions.
fields.description: Business Intelligence Analysts transform organisational data into dashboards, reports and insights that support management and strategic decision-making.
fields.education_requirements: Data Science and Analytics, Information Technology, Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Statistics or a related programme, supported by analytics skills.
fields.career_progression: Reporting Analyst → BI Analyst → Senior BI Analyst → BI Manager → Head of Business Intelligence.
fields.industries: Banking, insurance, retail, telecommunications, manufacturing, consulting and energy.
fields.recommended_skills: Advanced Excel, SQL, Power BI, Data Modelling, Data Visualisation, Business Analysis

fields.title: Data Scientist
fields.short_description: Use programming, statistics and machine learning to solve complex problems.
fields.description: Data scientists develop analytical models, use machine learning and examine large datasets to predict outcomes and solve complex organisational problems.
fields.education_requirements: Data Science and Analytics, Applied Statistics, Actuarial Science or Information Technology with strong mathematical and programming skills.
fields.career_progression: Junior Data Scientist → Data Scientist → Senior Data Scientist → Data Science Manager → Chief Data Officer.
fields.industries: Technology, banking, insurance, telecommunications, healthcare and research.
fields.recommended_skills: Python, Statistics, Machine Learning, SQL, Data Visualisation, Mathematical Modelling

fields.title: Database Administrator
fields.short_description: Manage, secure and maintain organisational databases.
fields.description: Database administrators maintain databases, manage access, monitor performance and protect organisational information.
fields.education_requirements: Information Technology, Data Science and Analytics or a related computing qualification.
fields.career_progression: IT Support Assistant → Database Administrator → Senior Database Administrator → Database Architect.
fields.industries: Banking, government, telecommunications, technology and healthcare.
fields.recommended_skills: SQL, Database Management, Database Security, Data Backup and Recovery, Problem Solving
fields.salary_notes: Entry-level estimates and estimates after five years of service. Net monthly salary. Senior-level figures not independently verified.

fields.title: IT Business Analyst
fields.short_description: Connect business needs with technology solutions.
fields.description: IT business analysts work with stakeholders to understand business requirements, document processes and help design technology solutions.
fields.education_requirements: Information Technology, Data Science and Analytics, Business Administration or a related programme.
fields.career_progression: Business Analyst Assistant → Business Analyst → Senior Business Analyst → Business Analysis Manager.
fields.industries: Technology, banking, insurance, telecommunications, consulting and government.
fields.recommended_skills: Business Process Modelling, Requirements Analysis, SQL, Documentation, Problem Solving

fields.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
fields.short_description: Protect computer systems, networks and organisational information.
fields.description: Cybersecurity analysts monitor systems, investigate security incidents and help organisations prevent unauthorised access and cyberattacks.
fields.education_requirements: Information Technology or a related computing programme, supported by cybersecurity training and practical experience.
fields.career_progression: IT Support Technician → Security Analyst → Security Engineer → Security Manager → Chief Information Security Officer.
fields.industries: Banking, telecommunications, government, technology and consulting.
fields.recommended_skills: Network Security, Cybersecurity Fundamentals, Linux, Incident Response, Critical Thinking

fields.title: Business Analyst
fields.short_description: Examine business problems and recommend practical improvements.
fields.description: Business analysts study organisational performance, processes and requirements to identify problems and recommend improvements.
fields.education_requirements: Business Administration, Management, Finance, Economics, Information Technology or a related programme.
fields.career_progression: Business Analyst Assistant → Business Analyst → Senior Business Analyst → Strategy Manager → Business Director.
fields.industries: Consulting, banking, insurance, technology, manufacturing and government.
fields.recommended_skills: Business Analysis, Excel, Power BI, Process Improvement, Critical Thinking, Communication
fields.salary_notes: Estimated salary benchmark based on the broader Management and Organisation Analysts occupational category. Not an exact salary range for every Business Analyst role.

fields.title: Operations Manager
fields.short_description: Coordinate people, resources and processes to improve organisational performance.
fields.description: Operations managers oversee daily business activities, monitor performance, manage resources and improve organisational efficiency.
fields.education_requirements: Business Administration, Management, Logistics, Accounting or a related programme.
fields.career_progression: Operations Assistant → Operations Supervisor → Operations Manager → General Manager → Chief Operating Officer.
fields.industries: Manufacturing, banking, logistics, retail, telecommunications and energy.
fields.recommended_skills: Operations Management, Project Management, Process Improvement, Leadership, Decision Making

fields.title: Human Resource Officer
fields.short_description: Support recruitment, employee relations and workforce administration.
fields.description: Human resource officers support recruitment, staff records, employee development, performance management and workplace relations.
fields.education_requirements: Business Administration, Management or another relevant programme, supported by HR training.
fields.career_progression: HR Assistant → HR Officer → HR Manager → HR Director → Chief Human Resources Officer.
fields.industries: Government, banking, insurance, consulting and private organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Recruitment, Human Resource Management, Conflict Resolution, Communication, Leadership
fields.salary_notes: Based on the broader Personnel and Careers Professionals occupational category. Estimates are not exclusive to Human Resource Officers.

fields.title: Project Manager
fields.short_description: Plan and coordinate projects to achieve defined objectives.
fields.description: Project managers plan activities, coordinate teams, manage budgets and monitor project delivery against agreed objectives.
fields.education_requirements: Business Administration, Management, IT, Logistics, Finance or a related programme, supported by project management experience.
fields.career_progression: Project Assistant → Project Coordinator → Project Manager → Programme Manager → Portfolio Director.
fields.industries: Construction, technology, banking, consulting, government and development organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Project Planning, Budget Management, Risk Management, Leadership, Time Management

fields.title: Management Consultant
fields.short_description: Help organisations solve problems and improve performance.
fields.description: Management consultants analyse organisational challenges and recommend strategies to improve efficiency, profitability and competitiveness.
fields.education_requirements: Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Accounting, Statistics or another relevant programme.
fields.career_progression: Consulting Analyst → Consultant → Senior Consultant → Manager → Partner.
fields.industries: Management consulting, financial services, government and multinational organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Business Strategy, Data Analysis, Problem Solving, Research, Presentation Skills
fields.salary_notes: Estimated salary benchmark based on the broader Management and Organisation Analysts occupational category. Not an exact salary range for every Management Consultant role.

fields.title: Marketing Manager
fields.short_description: Develop strategies to promote products, services and brands.
fields.description: Marketing managers plan campaigns, analyse customers and markets, manage marketing teams and evaluate promotional performance.
fields.education_requirements: Applied Marketing, Business Administration, Communication Studies or a related programme.
fields.career_progression: Marketing Assistant → Marketing Executive → Marketing Manager → Marketing Director → Chief Marketing Officer.
fields.industries: Retail, banking, telecommunications, media, manufacturing and technology.
fields.recommended_skills: Marketing Strategy, Market Research, Digital Marketing, Data Analysis, Creativity
fields.salary_notes: Estimated salary benchmark based on the broader Advertising and Marketing Professionals occupational category. Not an exact salary range for every Marketing Manager role.

fields.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
fields.short_description: Use digital channels to attract customers and grow brands.
fields.description: Digital marketing specialists manage online campaigns, social media, search marketing, digital content and online customer engagement.
fields.education_requirements: Applied Marketing, Communication Studies, Public Relations or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: Digital Marketing Assistant → Specialist → Digital Marketing Manager → Head of Digital Marketing.
fields.industries: Advertising, retail, technology, banking, media and e-commerce.
fields.recommended_skills: Social Media Marketing, SEO, Content Marketing, Google Analytics, Creativity

fields.title: Public Relations Officer
fields.short_description: Manage an organisation’s public image and stakeholder relationships.
fields.description: Public relations officers communicate organisational messages, coordinate media relations and help maintain positive relationships with stakeholders.
fields.education_requirements: Public Relations Management, Communication Studies, Applied French and Communications or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: PR Assistant → PR Officer → PR Manager → Communications Director.
fields.industries: Government, media, banking, telecommunications, NGOs and corporate organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Public Relations, Media Relations, Writing, Crisis Communication, Relationship Management
fields.salary_notes: Entry-level estimates and estimates after five years of service. Net monthly salary. Senior-level figures not independently verified.

fields.title: Corporate Communications Specialist
fields.short_description: Manage internal and external organisational communication.
fields.description: Corporate communications specialists develop communication strategies, prepare corporate messages and coordinate communication with employees, customers and stakeholders.
fields.education_requirements: Communication Studies, Public Relations Management, Applied French and Communications or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: Communications Assistant → Communications Specialist → Communications Manager → Corporate Affairs Director.
fields.industries: Banking, insurance, government, telecommunications and multinational organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Corporate Communication, Professional Writing, Stakeholder Management, Public Relations, Presentation Skills

fields.title: Market Research Analyst
fields.short_description: Study customer behaviour, market trends and competitive activity.
fields.description: Market research analysts collect and interpret customer and market information to help organisations make marketing and product decisions.
fields.education_requirements: Applied Marketing, Data Science and Analytics, Applied Statistics, Business Economics or Business Administration.
fields.career_progression: Research Assistant → Market Research Analyst → Senior Analyst → Research Manager.
fields.industries: Advertising, banking, telecommunications, retail and consulting.
fields.recommended_skills: Market Research, Statistical Analysis, Survey Design, Excel, Data Visualisation

fields.title: Supply Chain Analyst
fields.short_description: Analyse supply chain performance and identify operational improvements.
fields.description: Supply chain analysts examine purchasing, inventory, transportation and supplier performance to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
fields.education_requirements: Logistics and Transport Management, Business Administration, Accounting, Data Science or a related programme.
fields.career_progression: Supply Chain Assistant → Supply Chain Analyst → Supply Chain Manager → Supply Chain Director.
fields.industries: Manufacturing, retail, logistics, energy, mining and distribution.
fields.recommended_skills: Supply Chain Management, Inventory Analysis, Excel, Power BI, SQL

fields.title: Procurement Officer
fields.short_description: Manage purchasing activities and supplier relationships.
fields.description: Procurement officers source goods and services, evaluate suppliers, manage purchasing documentation and support cost-effective procurement.
fields.education_requirements: Logistics and Transport Management, Business Administration, Accounting or Management.
fields.career_progression: Procurement Assistant → Procurement Officer → Procurement Manager → Head of Procurement.
fields.industries: Government, manufacturing, construction, energy, healthcare and retail.
fields.recommended_skills: Procurement Management, Contract Management, Supplier Evaluation, Negotiation, Integrity

fields.title: Logistics Manager
fields.short_description: Coordinate transportation, warehousing and distribution operations.
fields.description: Logistics managers oversee the movement, storage and distribution of goods and services while monitoring cost, delivery and operational performance.
fields.education_requirements: Logistics and Transport Management, Business Administration or Management.
fields.career_progression: Logistics Assistant → Logistics Officer → Logistics Manager → Operations Director.
fields.industries: Transport, shipping, manufacturing, retail, mining and energy.
fields.recommended_skills: Logistics Management, Transportation Planning, Inventory Management, Leadership, Problem Solving

fields.title: Legal Practitioner
fields.short_description: Provide legal advice and represent clients within the legal system.
fields.description: Legal practitioners advise clients, interpret laws, prepare legal documents and represent clients in legal proceedings. Practising as a lawyer requires the relevant professional legal education and qualification.
fields.education_requirements: Bachelor of Laws (LLB), followed by the required professional legal training and qualification in the relevant jurisdiction.
fields.career_progression: Legal Trainee → Associate → Senior Associate → Partner or Independent Practitioner.
fields.industries: Law firms, government, courts, corporate legal departments and NGOs.
fields.recommended_skills: Legal Research, Legal Writing, Contract Law, Critical Thinking, Advocacy
fields.salary_notes: Lawyers occupational benchmark. Net monthly estimates; actual earnings depend on qualification, experience and employer.

fields.title: Compliance Officer
fields.short_description: Help organisations comply with laws, regulations and internal policies.
fields.description: Compliance officers monitor regulatory requirements, review organisational procedures and help prevent legal and regulatory violations.
fields.education_requirements: Law, Accounting, Banking and Finance or Business Administration, with relevant compliance training.
fields.career_progression: Compliance Assistant → Compliance Officer → Compliance Manager → Chief Compliance Officer.
fields.industries: Banking, insurance, telecommunications, government and corporate organisations.
fields.recommended_skills: Regulatory Compliance, Risk Assessment, Legal Research, Documentation, Integrity

fields.title: Real Estate Analyst
fields.short_description: Analyse property markets, investments and real estate performance.
fields.description: Real estate analysts evaluate property markets, rental income, investment opportunities and financial performance to support property decisions.
fields.education_requirements: Real Estate Management and Finance, Finance, Accounting or Business Economics.
fields.career_progression: Property Analyst Assistant → Real Estate Analyst → Senior Analyst → Investment Manager.
fields.industries: Property development, real estate investment, banking, valuation and consulting.
fields.recommended_skills: Property Valuation, Financial Modelling, Market Research, Excel, Investment Analysis

fields.title: Property Manager
fields.short_description: Manage properties, tenants, maintenance and property operations.
fields.description: Property managers oversee residential and commercial properties, coordinate maintenance, manage tenants and monitor property performance.
fields.education_requirements: Real Estate Management and Finance, Business Administration or Management.
fields.career_progression: Property Assistant → Property Officer → Property Manager → Head of Property Management.
fields.industries: Real estate, property development, facilities management and investment companies.
fields.recommended_skills: Property Management, Facilities Management, Financial Administration, Customer Service, Negotiation
fields.salary_notes: Real estate agents and property managers occupational benchmark. Net monthly estimates.

fields.title: Agribusiness Manager
fields.short_description: Manage the commercial and financial operations of agricultural businesses.
fields.description: Agribusiness managers oversee agricultural enterprises, supply chains, financial planning, production and market development.
fields.education_requirements: Agribusiness and Finance, Business Administration, Accounting or Finance.
fields.career_progression: Agribusiness Assistant → Operations Officer → Agribusiness Manager → Managing Director.
fields.industries: Agriculture, food processing, agricultural finance, commodity trading and distribution.
fields.recommended_skills: Agribusiness Management, Financial Planning, Supply Chain Management, Market Analysis, Entrepreneurship

fields.title: Entrepreneur
fields.short_description: Create and grow a business by identifying and pursuing opportunities.
fields.description: Entrepreneurs identify market needs, develop business models, mobilise resources and build ventures that create economic and social value.
fields.education_requirements: Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, IT, Agribusiness or any relevant programme. Practical business skills and experience are important.
fields.career_progression: Business Founder → Business Owner → Managing Director → Business Group Leader.
fields.industries: Technology, agriculture, retail, consulting, finance, education and creative industries.
fields.recommended_skills: Business Planning, Financial Management, Marketing, Leadership, Problem Solving, Negotiation

fields.title: French Language Specialist
fields.short_description: Use French language expertise in business, communication and international settings.
fields.description: French language specialists support translation, interpretation, international communication and multilingual business activities.
fields.education_requirements: Applied French and Communications or another relevant language qualification.
fields.career_progression: Language Assistant → French Specialist → Senior Language Professional → International Communications Manager.
fields.industries: International organisations, diplomacy, tourism, education, trade and multinational companies.
fields.recommended_skills: French Language, Translation, Interpretation, Cross-Cultural Communication, Research

fields.title: International Business Development Officer
fields.short_description: Identify international markets and develop cross-border business relationships.
fields.description: International business development officers research foreign markets, identify business opportunities and build relationships with international partners.
fields.education_requirements: Business Administration, Applied French and Communications, Marketing, Economics or Logistics.
fields.career_progression: Business Development Assistant → International Business Officer → Regional Manager → International Business Director.
fields.industries: International trade, logistics, manufacturing, consulting and multinational companies.
fields.recommended_skills: International Business, Market Research, Negotiation, Cross-Cultural Communication, Business Strategy

fields.title: Statistician
fields.short_description: Collect, analyse and interpret numerical information.
fields.description: Statisticians design studies, analyse datasets and apply statistical methods to help organisations understand trends and make evidence-based decisions.
fields.education_requirements: Applied Statistics, Data Science and Analytics, Actuarial Science or another quantitative programme.
fields.career_progression: Statistical Assistant → Statistician → Senior Statistician → Research or Analytics Manager.
fields.industries: Government, research, healthcare, banking, insurance and consulting.
fields.recommended_skills: Statistical Analysis, Probability, R or Python, Data Visualisation, Research Methods
fields.salary_notes: Mathematicians, actuaries and statisticians occupational benchmark. Net monthly estimates.

fields.title: Research Analyst
fields.short_description: Conduct research and turn findings into useful recommendations.
fields.description: Research analysts gather information, design research activities, analyse findings and prepare reports for organisations and decision-makers.
fields.education_requirements: Business Economics, Applied Statistics, Data Science, Business Administration, Marketing or Communication Studies.
fields.career_progression: Research Assistant → Research Analyst → Senior Research Analyst → Research Manager.
fields.industries: Consulting, government, banking, NGOs, education and market research.
fields.recommended_skills: Research Methods, Data Analysis, Report Writing, Excel, Critical Thinking
